content:
Hello! New player here, really loving this game and definitely gonna be playing this daily

Just have a few questions with my roster and the (upcoming/present)banners

Who should I pull for or save for?

Is it fine to keep pulling for Aequor awakeners? (Really love their character designs, thinking of getting Corposant/Pontos)

Is it worth pulling on the Moonless Guide or Before Memories Fade? (I already bought some silver prime so wanna make use of it, gotta support the game! ^^)

What should I use my standard pulls for?

And any advice, tips or tricks overall?

Thank you!

**1.**
I'd recommend saving your pulls til after GLotan's kit is revealed as she may be a strong character; in general, pulls are usually saved for characters you can form D-Zone teams around. D-Zone is the main endgame content and requires you to make at least 5 teams. Thus, most players recommend to invest *horizontally* into creating more teams than vertically scaling one team since the rewards from D-Zone are limited per its cycle while the story mode will be permanent. 

Characters that you form teams around are more often than not DPS characters (which coincidentally the current triple banners all feature, which is great). Characters in this game rely on dupes more often than not, so try to see what enlightenment level you want to achieve and plan your pulls accordingly. A great resource to look into is this guide: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1THjxR9hHs4NWHqSWHHa2dHAGuE_cRGelfzXdBfCnIlM/edit?tab=t.9ndp3ofgzwqw

You may be wondering "how can I figure out what teams to form?" You can either ask for recommendations here, but you can also view what people use to complete Alert 5 on D-Zone to see common team archetypes as well.

**2.**
Regarding the standard banner pulls, you can pull whoever you really want to tbh. Morimens puposefully gives tons of standard pulls and it's designed for you to be constantly using them. Because of this, you will inevitably unlock all the regular characters at some point.

Personally, I'd recommend getting a single copy of all the regular characters and then start investing into the teams you want to fill out more. Additionally, there's something known as "Wheel Jail" which is a way the community refers to trying to get +12 on a Wheel of Destiny. This effect is very powerful as it lets you **equip two SSR wheels on a single character**. 

Continue pulling on what you want as you will eventually unlock all the standards. As you progress through the campaign and other events, you will eventually decide on what you want more.

**3.**
Moonless Guide is one of the best banners for new players as it allows you to gain access to several powerful Faded Legacy (Arc 1) characters. If you did not know, the game has two types of limited characters that fall under the designation of "Faded Legacy" and "Astral Reign" corresponding to arcs 1 & 2 of the game. Typically, Arc 2 characters are stonger than Arc I; however, there are two specific characters that are very strong even compared to current Arc 2 characters. Those being: Thais & Horla. 

It's recommended to fill 2 of the 4 Moonless slots with Thais & Horla and add in two other limited characters. You can check the guide for recommendations and specifications for when to stop pulling.

**Before Memories Fade** CAN be a useful banner for filling out your roster. **HOWEVER**, it is important to note that you are **DIRECTLY GAMBLING** with what you can potentially get. There is no guarantee you'll get a specific character that you want, and it can even end up giving you dupes of a character you already have. Thus, these banners are generally not recommended as your silver prime will get much better value on other things like the pre-order packs. 

**4.** 
I went over this in #2, but you can use them on anything! You get a lot and are supposed to use them. I'd personally recommend trying to get all the characters first before moving onto either trying to get higher enlightenments for a team or wheel jail.

**5.** 
Take your time and have fun. Morimens is a unique and splendidly crafted world that has seen lots of love and attention from the devs. One of the most appealing characteristics is the emphasis on strategy. 

You can spend hundreds of dollars on the game, but if you do not fundamentally understand how the characters work or what your enemies are going to do, you will die. 

If that happens, take the a deep breath and see what you could do differently. Ask questions here! The community is pretty open. Also, tap on stuff. A lot of details and explanations on certain mechanics can be seen by simply tapping or holding down. Good luck!

(Oh last thing, Saya and her wheel are VERY strong and it is highly recommended that you at least grab an individual copy of both. Saya is one of the strongest supports in the game and her wheel gives +1 arithmetica which boosts any team.)

I clear most contents with Saya-Thaïs-Corpo-Aurita
Requieres a bit of managment but should work for you if you like shuffle : )

Quick reminder : you will eventually want 5 functionnal teams.
Also, chasing wheels might not be a priority right now, some R WoDs are plenty powerful.
